name: Vibe App Builder
tagline: Describe what you want — I generate a working dashboard and a persistent agent to manage it.
description: Vibe App Builder is a one-shot agent invoked from the web entry input box. Given a single natural-language request (e.g., '我要一个客户跟进看板'), it generates a working dashboard, a persistent chat agent tailored to the app, and a workspace artifact bundle. The generated agent is auto-published to TalentHub and hired for the requesting user, who can then iterate on the app via chat.
